description: Source code for a JSON schema code generator class implementing draft 06 of the JSON Schema specification, including validation methods and regex patterns.

classes.name: CodeGeneratorDraft06
classes.description: A class extending CodeGeneratorDraft04 to implement JSON Schema draft 06 validation and code generation.

methods.name: _generate_func_code_block
methods.description: Generates code block based on schema definition, handling boolean schemas and references.

methods.name: generate_boolean_schema
methods.description: Handles schemas defined as boolean, indicating always valid or invalid.

methods.name: generate_type
methods.description: Validates the 'type' keyword, supporting multiple types and special handling for integers and floats.

methods.name: generate_property_names
methods.description: Validates object property names against a schema.

methods.name: generate_contains
methods.description: Validates that an array contains at least one item matching a schema.

methods.name: generate_const
methods.description: Validates that a value equals a constant specified in the schema.
